tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submit an experience certificate obtained from the district/taluk level officers of the department as per Annexure-2 given in the tender regarding satisfactory service of 300 staff in each of the years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. (Experience certificate obtained in the name of a single organization should be submitted.)
The company should be registered under the Register of Companies (ROC). A certificate to this effect

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The company should be registered under the Register of Companies (ROC). A certificate to this effect

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The organization should submit a Registration Certificate of Establishment Form 'C' from the Labor Department and should have a minimum of 800 employees registered in the said Registration Certificate. The registration should be done before the date of calling for tenders
Submitting the organization's PAN number

The Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration certificate must be valid. A minimum of Rs. 50.00 lakh in GST must have been paid for each of the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. This will be verified online: no documents need to be submitted for this purpose

Submit the EPF Registration Certificate. Additionally, submit EPF payment challans demonstrating a minimum payment of Rs. 1 crore for each of the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. (The submitted challans must be in the name of the same organization.)
Submission of ECR File Challans regarding EPF payments for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. (Only challans paid under the name of the same organization should be submitted.)

Submit the ESI Registration Certificate. Also, submit ESI payment challans demonstrating a minimum payment of Rs. 40 lakh for each of the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. (The submitted challans must be in the name of the same organization.)
Submission of ESI ECR file challans for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. (Challans paid under the name of the same establishment must be submitted.)

The existing Contract Labour Liaison, Registration Certificate should be registered for the service of at least 450 personnel under the (Registration and Abolition) Act 1970 (Copy should be attached.)
Submission of self-declared affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper stating that the bidder is not blacklisted. (First party bidder and second party tender should be in the name of the inviting authority.)

Submission of an affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper stating that all disputes will be settled within the jurisdiction of the local district court. (The first party should be in the name of the bidder and the second party should be in the name of the tender inviting authority.)
MSME Registration Certificate
Police Verification Registration Certificate must be valid

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Submission of challans for the payment of professional tax for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. (Challans paid in the name of the same organization must be submitted.)
Submission of GST returns (GST RI 3B) for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. This will be verified online: there is no requirement to submit any physical documents.
Submission of Income Tax Returns for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. (The Income Tax Returns submitted must be in the name of the same entity.)

Submit a confirmation letter from a Chartered Accountant (CA) certifying a turnover of at least Rs. 15 crore for each of the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26, along with the Balance Sheets (including Profit & Loss statements) for the past three years. (The submitted Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss statements must be in the name of the same entity.)
